title: Neighborhood Watch
overview: When a mentally ill young man thinks he witnesses an abduction and the police refuse to believe him, he reluctantly turns to his next door neighbor – a bitter, retired security guard – to help him find the missing woman.

title: Opus
overview: A young writer is invited to the remote compound of a legendary pop star who mysteriously disappeared thirty years ago. Surrounded by the star's cult of sycophants and intoxicated journalists, she finds herself in the middle of his twisted plan.

title: Grafted
overview: When an awkward but brilliant Chinese student wins a scholarship into a prestigious New Zealand University, she finds a new way of achieving the popularity she craves one bloody body at a time.

title: Eye for an Eye
overview: Anna, grieving the sudden death of her parents, relocates from New York to a small Florida town to live with the grandmother she has never met. Isolated, vulnerable, and in need of friends, she finds brief solace in the company of two local teens. But when she becomes complicit to their unforgivable act of violence, she finds herself ensnared by Mr. Sandman – the twisted soul of a tormented child who haunts bullies’ dreams before feasting on their eyeballs when they finally wake - Anna must right her wrong before becoming a victim of this gruesome curse.

title: Out of Control
overview: Julien and Marie have enjoyed 15 years of seemingly stable marriage until Anaëlle, Julien’s childhood flame, returns. Her sudden presence awakens old insecurities in Marie, who begins to doubt Julien’s devotion and question her self-worth. Amid this emotional storm, Marie is drawn to Thomas, a charismatic stranger who offers her the validation she craves.

title: John Cranko
overview: The gifted, charismatic artist John Cranko moves to the Swabian province from London, where he is attacked for his homosexuality, and after many crises becomes the great sensation as the new pop star of the arts: the Stuttgart Ballet Miracle.

title: Black Ox
overview: The life of a man, transitioning from a hunter-gatherer existence in the mountains to a life in the farm. One day, he comes across an ox, which somehow, he succeeds in leading back to his home. He lives with the animal, which becomes his companion in a life of changing seasons.

title: Hear Me: Our Summer
overview: A job seeking dreamer Yong-jun works part-time at his parents' lunch box house. Yeo-reum lives only to support for hearing-impaired swimmer sister. One day, Yong-jun meets Yeo-reum while delivering lunch boxes and falls in love at the first sight. Yeo-reum slowly opens her heart to warm-hearted Yong-jun.

title: Creation of the Gods III: Creation Under Heaven
overview: Ji Fa unites the princes of the four directions to march into Chaoge. Yin Shou and Tong Tian Jiaozhu set up the 'Nine-bend Yellow River Formation' and the 'Zhu Xian Formation'. Yuan Shi Tianzun brings the twelve golden immortals down the mountain, and the war between the three realms of humans, immortals and demons is about to break out.

title: Robot T-O
overview: In a near future, Max and her daughter are selling stolen robots on the black market. When Max loses custody of her daughter following their latest scheme, she must rely on the last robot she took, T-O, who is ready to do anything to help.

title: Vermiglio
overview: In the last days of the Second World War, a deserting soldier disrupts a tranquil and isolated mountain community. For one family, his arrival brings excitement and romance, but tragedy lies in wait.

title: Tropicana
overview: A lonely middle-aged woman divides her time between her monotonous job at the supermarket and taking care of her disabled mother and estranged family members. The mysterious murder of the head cashier at the supermarket, sends her on a journey into the depths of her repressed desire revealing her deep longing for warmth and human connection.

title: The Radleys
overview: A seemingly ordinary family harbors a dark secret: they are vampires. They choose not to drink blood despite their natural cravings, but one day, their truth comes to light.

title: Three Friends
overview: Joan is no longer in love with Victor, but it pains her to feel she is being dishonest with him. Alice, her best friend, reassures her: She herself doesn’t feel passionate about her partner Eric and yet their relationship is smooth sailing. She has no idea he is having an affair with Rebecca, their mutual friend. When Joan finally decides to leave Victor and he disappears, the lives of the three friends and their relationships are turned upside down.

title: Last Straw
overview: A rural roadside diner becomes the host of a maniacal killing spree – leaving a young waitress to clean up the mess. After hard-headed Nancy fires the staff at her dad’s diner, she decides to cover the last shift of the night by herself. Little does she know, she is far from alone. The day is coming back to haunt her and when things begin to spiral out of control, she must fight for her life over the course of one long night.

title: Meiyazhagan
overview: Twenty-two years after losing his home, Arulmozhi Varman returns to his native Thanjavur to attend his cousin's wedding. Amidst the celebrations, Arul is reintroduced to an upbeat man whom he cannot recall. With the help of the unknown man, Arul reconnects with his past.

title: The Greatest of All Time
overview: A once decorated member of the Special Anti-Terrorism Squad (SATS) is called back into action by his former colleagues for an important mission, setting him on a dangerous collision course with his own past.

title: Cleaner
overview: When a group of radical activists take over an energy company's annual gala, seizing 300 hostages, an ex-soldier turned window cleaner suspended 50 storeys up on the outside of the building must save those trapped inside, including her older brother.

title: The Lesbian Alien Dark Room Fisting Operetta on Venus
original_title: The Lesbian Alien Dark Room Fisting Operetta on Venus
overview: The angels have given the Captain of the Sea Butches the holy assignment to travel to a lesbian bar on Venus to get hold of the strongest vibrator in the whole universe – the weapon needed in the fight to destroy the phallic tower of the evil gentrifiers.

title: Ice Road: Vengeance
overview: Big rig ice road driver Mike McCann travels to Nepal to scatter his late brother’s ashes on Mt. Everest. While on a packed tour bus traversing the deadly 12,000 ft. terrain of the infamous Road to the Sky, McCann and his mountain guide encounter a group of mercenaries and must fight to save themselves, the busload of innocent travelers, and the local villagers’ homeland.

title: Naples to New York
overview: In the immediate post-war period, amidst the rubble of a poverty-ridden Naples, two kids, Carmine and Celestina, try to survive as best they can by helping each other out. One night, they secretly board a ship bound for New York to reach Celestina’s sister, who emigrated to America several years earlier.  The two children join the many Italian emigrants seeking a new life in America and arrive in an unknown metropolis, which, after several misadventures, they will learn to call home.

title: I'll Be Right There
overview: Wanda wants to take care of everyone in her life. She barely has time for herself, not that she would know what to do with it anyway.

title: War 2
overview: Years ago Agent Kabir went rogue, became India’s greatest villain ever.  As he descends further into the deepest shadows... India sends its deadliest, most lethal agent after him, Agent Vikram  A Special Units Officer who is more than Kabir’s equal and a relentless Terminator driven by his own demons, determined to put a bullet into Kabir’s skull.

title: Sing 3
overview: The third installment in the Sing franchise. Plot TBA.

title: Pets on a Train
overview: When a train unexpectedly starts up, taking only pets with it, the animals discover that Hans, a badger with a grudge is behind it all. While the crash seems inevitable, the animals can count on Falcon, a roguish Raccoon who will do anything to save them.

title: Unreachable
overview: Three young women live together in an old house in a corner of Tokyo. They are not related by blood, but they have been bound together by a strong bond for 12 years. They care about each other and spend their own ordinary days together. The matter of unrequited love arises for them that they can't tell anyone.

title: Jurassic Shark 3: Seavenge
overview: A reporter, cameraman, and some petty thieves are stranded in a boat out on the ocean. The only thing that stands between them and their lives is a 50-foot prehistoric megalodon shark. They must all pull together to survive.

title: Echo Valley
overview: Kate lives a secluded life—until her troubled daughter shows up, frightened and covered in someone else's blood. As Kate unravels the shocking truth, she learns just how far a mother will go to try to save her child.

title: The Ties That Bind Us
overview: A young single father trying to find the strength to love. A feminist librarian, single by conviction, who’s decided that she won’t be a mother. A six-year-old child trying to find a place in a new family structure. By revealing their aspirations, their fears, their choices, Carine Tardieu depicts different ways in which humans create families.

title: Y2K

title: Black Diamond
overview: Follows a young woman whose idyllic life with her hedge funder boyfriend turns it into a deadly triangle of lust, obsession and murder after meeting a local cowboy handyman.

title: The Room Next Door

Ingrid went on to become an autofiction novelist while Martha became a war reporter, and they were separated by the circumstances of life. After years of being out of touch, they meet again in an extreme but strangely sweet situation.

title: I Hate Summer

title: Loveable

Rule, a fiery-tempered rebel tattoo artist, doesn’t have time for a good girl pre-med student like Shaw — even if she’s the only one who can see the person he truly is. She lives by other people’s rules; he makes his own. But a short skirt, too many birthday cocktails, and spilled secrets lead to a night neither can forget. Now, Shaw and Rule must figure out how a girl like her and a guy like him are supposed to be together without destroying their love…or each other.

title: O'Dessa
overview: A farm girl is on an epic quest to recover a cherished family heirloom. Her journey leads her to a strange and dangerous city where she meets her one true love – but in order to save his soul, she must put the power of destiny and song to the ultimate test.

The Ultimate DVD offers you a unique entertainment experience, featuring reference quality sights and sounds designed to fully exploit your system's capabilities.  Indulge your senses with some of the most breath-taking visuals ever captured on film.  Immerse yourself in state-of-the-art high resolution audio and digital surround sound.  Sit back, relax and enjoy the "ultimate home theater sensation!"

title: Bambi: The Reckoning
overview: After a mother and son get in a car wreck, they soon become hunted by Bambi, a mutated grief-stricken deer on a deadly rampage seeking revenge for the death of his mother and wife.

title: Winner
overview: Winner is a brilliant young misfit from Texas who finds her morals challenged while serving in the U.S. Air Force and working as an NSA contractor. A fresh take on the traditional whistleblower thriller, the coming-of-age story follows an idealistic young woman persecuted for standing by her principles.

title: Milk Teeth
overview: Skalde lives in a small rural community, far from a world that may no longer exist. She is an interloper in her own home, having been born to an ‘outsider’ mother and therefore marked by a social stigma she cannot easily erase. Displaying a loyalty to the codes of the community, she has earned the respect of the village elder. However, when she encounters a mysterious girl in the local woods, Skalde risks everything by befriending her, eventually giving the girl a home.

title: The Alto Knights
overview: Two of New York's most notorious organized crime bosses, Frank Costello and Vito Genovese, vie for control of the city's streets. Once the best of friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals place them on a deadly collision course that will reshape the Mafia (and America) forever.

title: U Are the Universe
overview: After the explosion of the Earth, the Ukrainian space trucker Andriy becomes the only human in the Universe until French woman Catherine calls him from the faraway space station. Andriy decides to see her despite all the obstacles.

title: Listen to the Voices
overview: Melrick is an unruly young boy who spends his summer in French Guiana at his grandmother's house to escape his turbulent daily life in Stains, France. At the end of his stay, he plays the drum to revive the memory of his late uncle, Lucas Diomar, who died in tragic circumstances. Despite a wave of murders of young men shaking the headlines, Melrick becomes aware of his place in a family destroyed by irreparable grief.

title: Valiant One

overview: When Olmo gets invited to a party by his beautiful neighbor, he will do whatever he can to meet up with her, embarking on a night of laughs and chaos.

overview: Paring Bert, a priest, and his parishioner, Santos, a taxi driver, embark on a gritty journey to reconcile their moral conflicts while they elude an assassination attempt.

title: Cannelloni

It is an inescapable, suffocating, and deadly spiral of vengeance that unfolds over the course of a single night.

title: Wei Baba

title: ATEEZ: LIGHT THE WAY IN CINEMAS
original_title: ATEEZ: LIGHT THE WAY IN CINEMAS
overview: One day, a mysterious message arrives for ATEEZ, who had been spending a peaceful time in their hideout. At that moment, everything began to change. Pursued by an unknown force, ATEEZ begins to fight back to find ATINY.

title: Playback
overview: PLAYBACK is not just a biopic about Carlos Paião. It's a journey into the creative universe of one of the greatest geniuses of Portuguese music. Carlos studies Medicine, lives among books, exams, and expectations, but it is in the secret of melodies, words, and imagination that he finds the place where he truly breathes. In a country still discovering new sounds, he risks exchanging the security of a white coat for the uncertainty of stages, songs, and a dream bigger than himself. Between duty and desire, reason and intuition, fear and courage, Carlos builds a unique path, made of talent, humor, creative obsession, and an almost luminous urgency to leave his mark. PLAYBACK reveals not only the songs that made Carlos Paião an unforgettable figure in Portuguese music, but also the intimate universe from which they were born.

title: Prosecution
overview: After surviving a racist attack, state prosecutor Seyo Kim takes her own case to court – confronting both the perpetrators and a justice system that turns a blind eye to right-wing extremism.

title: Hive
overview: A strict, anxious teenager loses the child she’s babysitting and must brave a sinister force hiding in plain sight among the children in the playground. As her world unravels and her grip on reality starts to slip, she must outwit a world where nothing is as it seems to make it out alive.

title: RRR
overview: A fictional history of two legendary revolutionaries' journey away from home before they began fighting for their country in the 1920s.

title: Shin Godzilla
overview: When a massive, gilled monster emerges from the deep and tears through the city, the government scrambles to save its citizens.  A rag-tag team of volunteers cuts through a web of red tape to uncover the monster's weakness and its mysterious ties to a foreign superpower.  But time is not on their side - the greatest catastrophe to ever befall the world is about to evolve right before their very eyes.

title: Ohh My Dog
overview: In Assam, 14-year-old Apu embarks on a desperate quest to rescue his beloved dog, Momo, after he is kidnapped. Elsewhere, in Bihar, a devoted dog named Oscar sets out on a perilous journey to find his kidnapped owner, a 15-year-old child labourer. As their journeys unfold, it becomes clear that the two kidnappings may be connected to a larger, sinister plan.

title: Everytime
overview: A tragedy brings a mother, daughter, and teenage boy together. Struggling with blame and forgiveness, the unlikely trio take a trip to Tenerife  for a family holiday that never happened. Under the glow of the sun,  past and present quietly start to overlap.

title: Toko Perlengkapan Mayat
overview: Daeng Sarro, the owner of a mortuary supplies business, asks his children and grandchildren to come and stay at his house in a remote village after his wife dies, until the mourning period is over. However, due to urgent matters, Rahma must return to the city, while her children remain at home. Day by day, various mysterious events begin to haunt Daeng Sarro's grandchildren.

title: Grin
overview: While visiting her family, Eva is introduced to her mother’s new partner, Lucian. When the group play Lucian’s mysterious old board game for the first time, they begin to believe it has summoned a demonic entity that punishes those who have committed terrible sins. After a series of terrifying encounters, the players begin going missing one by one. Eva soon realizes the game is more deadly than she could ever have imagined.

title: The Rope Curse 4: Kuntilanak
overview: A forbidden exorcism is livestreamed in Indonesia, awakening the legendary female spirit Kuntilanak. What begins as an online spectacle quickly turns deadly. In Taiwan, Mila watches the ritual—and becomes the curse’s first victim. Soon, mysterious deaths and violent possessions follow. When Yulan collapses and is found to have lost part of her soul, it becomes clear that this is not an isolated incident, but a transnational curse. Seeking answers, Mila’s son returns her ashes to Indonesia, hoping to uncover the truth behind her death. Instead, he steps into a nightmare rooted in ancient folklore and unresolved hatred. As supernatural violence escalates, the group realizes that once Kuntilanak is summoned, the curse will not stop—until it claims everything in its path.

title: Большой друг
overview: Vova and Misha are participants in a charity project where any adult can become a mentor for a child from an orphanage. They've been friends for over six months and have a great time together. Vova teaches Misha to drive and is concerned about his college admissions. Everything changes when Misha gets another mentor – Irina, a woman who wants to adopt him.

title: Last Night I Conquered the City of Thebes
overview: On a cold winter afternoon, António and Jota return from the front with their friends, looking for an ancient Roman thermal bath. They joke with each other while wading through swamps, recounting past tactical glories. The baths have appeared after a long time spent under the water of a reservoir, and people of all ages curious about the discovery come to spend the day. But there is something mysterious about these thermal waters - as if the baths influence the mood of the men, giving them the courage to say things they have never told anyone. As day turns to night, they confess their feelings and their fears of losing their best friend forever.

title: The Sun Never Sets
overview: Wendy’s life is thrown into chaos when her boyfriend, Jack, who is older and divorced with children, insists they take space to evaluate the relationship. During their break, Wendy runs into her ex, Chuck, forcing them into a volatile triangle.

title: The Betrayal
overview: Anthony and Will explore a new food, only to be interrupted by the death of their close friend, Hanbon.

title: The Ox Is Coming
overview: Set on the grasslands, the story follows a newborn calf named "Niu Lai" who leads a lark—which has flown in from the desert—into a dream. In the dream, the lark witnesses the calf's growth as it learns to take on responsibilities and confront life and death.

title: The Ghost Killer
overview: Old Wu, once a top assassin, lived a peaceful life under an assumed name at the Renxintang Pharmacy. However, this tranquility was shattered when single mother Song Xiaoqian was kidnapped by a gang. To rescue Xiaoqian, Old Wu returned to the underworld, engaging in a life-or-death struggle against a criminal gang led by Third Master and Zuo Lun. In the process, Old Wu uncovered the truth behind the murder of his wife and daughter ten years prior, discovering that the mastermind behind it all was none other than Master Xiang, whom he once respected. Ultimately, with his superb martial arts skills and unwavering conviction, Old Wu avenged his family and the innocent by killing his enemies and delivering justice.

title: Masterni
overview: A girl goes missing, leaving the nation in shock as every lead goes cold.

title: Last Summer
overview: Min-woo, a young man who works at a local office in a rural village, lives with his father and grandmother and often hangs out with his close friend Seong-hoon. The weather is not exactly what the farmers want, and Min-woo continues to lead a quiet life.

title: Barreda
overview: A fictionalized drama film based on one of the most shocking crimes in Argentina's history. In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

title: The Invisibles
overview: The story follows a family of five, living quietly and away from prying eyes on the Izu Islands—including the youngest daughter, born invisible. Their mother, who had raised her cheerfully, has passed away from illness, and their anxious father has devoted himself to hiding his daughters from the world. One day, however, they must set out on a journey to visit their grandmother, a famous actress living in Tokyo.

title: Spirit Guardians: The Last Secret of the First Emperor
original_title: Hộ Linh Tráng Sĩ: Bí ẩn mộ Vua Đinh
overview: Based on the folklore about the 7 warriors and the mystery of the tomb of Emperor Dinh.

Malvina, an imaginary friend from childhood, comes to his aid, a freakish woman with purple hair and a quirky sense of humor. Malvina pushes Vasya to find her childhood love, Stasik. Vasya will go through a long journey and understand what went wrong in her life, but most importantly, she will learn why Malvina appeared.

title: Doctor in Duty
overview: A woman's health specialist is unwillingly required to be on full day and night duty aA woman's health specialist is unwillingly required to be on full day and night duty at hospital, a teenage girl asks the Dr for abortion to be performed for her. The film deals with the subject of abortion — a sensitive and universal issue. In many countries, restrictive laws cause deep harm to women or to children born into difficult circumstances. The film was completed three years ago, just one month before the “Woman, Life, Freedom” movement in Iran, during a time of strict regulations regarding women’s presence and dress. Post-production was paused for a year, and it was finally released in 2024. Through a blend of realism and surreal imagery, the film seeks to challenge social perceptions of women’s choices — whether to keep a child or to consider abortion If I wanted to make this film now under the current conditions, it would definitely have a different structure!

title: The Burial of the Black Cat
overview: An 11-year-old girl meets her sister, who has transitioned and is now her brother. Struggling to accept this, she makes him reenact scenes from their childhood to mend their bond.

title: Binding Eva

title: Supernova

title: Ithaqua

When an excellent performance allows someone to be spared by the machine, the crew think they’ve figured out how to finally beat it. Proven almost immediately wrong, it takes more horrifying deaths and a visit from a mysterious stranger to realize they may have a chance at survival after all.

title: Bad Ramen
overview: A ramen date goes south when the girl suddenly falls ill at dinner and begins exhibiting sinister behavior.

overview: The Sunshine Recorder is a new home therapy device, using artificial inelegance to analyse recordings of dreams.

overview: Dr. Craig O'Connell and Aliah Banchik deploy state-of-the-art tech as they try to capture the thresher's deadly tail whip on film in the Philippines.

overview: A man of unwavering convictions returns with his family to the remote island of his childhood to open a music school for orphaned children, but beneath the island's beauty lies an unseen darkness.

title: AAA Verano de Escàndalo 2026 - Week 2

Plus, La Parka, Mecha Wolf, and Lince Dorado battle for a spot at Triplemanía and the opportunity to challenge for the AAA Latin American Championship. Also, Galeno teams up with Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. to take on Drago and Dinámico.

title: Tripolar
overview: "...you probably would not wish to change; and even if you did wish it, you would still not do anything, because in fact there is perhaps nothing to change into."

title: Creampie
overview: A story with a creamy twist. Gemma moves in with her boyfriend at a friend’s creampie house, only to uncover the sinful secret behind the town’s most famous creampie business.

title: A Quiet Place Part II
overview: Following the events at home, the Abbott family now face the terrors of the outside world. Forced to venture into the unknown, they realize that the creatures that hunt by sound are not the only threats that lurk beyond the sand path.

title: Operation Jachnun

The three are sent on a complex journey that takes them beyond the boundaries of a routine military operation, through hostile territory, unclear orders, and unexpected situations.  But before they can get their hands on the weapon that could change the course of the conflict, they must complete one unexpected task: find a Yemenite soldier.

title: Merci Charlotte !
overview: In a romantic jazz bar atmosphere, Émile’s first date takes an unexpected turn when he realizes the woman he’s meeting has lied about her age.

overview: Experts analyze shark encounters caught on camera, using forensics to review bite marks and behavior patterns as they wonder: What shark attacked?

overview: Experts attempt to train great white sharks using cues and challenges to test learning, memory, and decision-making in the wild.

title: Scotty
overview: A stray cat (Scotty) has to travel with a pet cat (Katie) despite his desire to return to his territory, but when he gets home, he realizes that living with those he loves is better than living alone.

title: Tomb Quest
overview: In a suburban basement, five old friends meet on the night of their friend's funeral to fulfill his final request: finish the Tomb Quest role-playing campaign they abandoned after their high school graduation.

title: The Blow
overview: Nineteen-year-old Enzo and his twenty-year-old sister Carla have been left to fend for themselves for several years. When their father, Anthony, is released from prison, Enzo sees the fragile promise of a family to rebuild, unlike Carla, for whom the idea remains inconceivable. Haunted by his past, Enzo must confront a truth he has kept hidden for far too long.

title: Where They Whisper
overview: Two friends venture into an abandoned building in search of adventure, only to discover that some places are abandoned for a reason.

title: Margeado
overview: The river is not the same. It has turned into contaminated mud. Residents of a fishing village face an uncertain future after the dam burst. Yara and Dingue resume their lives, remain and drift in the memory of the place while the waters run down the mountains in the face of the indomitable forces of nature.

title: Ashes
overview: One night. One gun. Two estranged brothers reunited by the man who killed their parents and a choice that will either damn them both or lead one to grace.

title: Jared Leto: Hollywood's Dark Secret
overview: An investigative documentary exploring long-standing and newly detailed allegations of sexual misconduct, grooming, and criminal sexual conduct against Oscar-winning actor and Thirty Seconds to Mars frontman Jared Leto.

title: Simon Says
overview: A group of friends gathers for a party when a mysterious entertainer named Simon arrives to host a game of Simon Says. What begins as a harmless game becomes a deadly fight for survival, where one wrong move can cost them their lives.

title: Camphor Tiger Chase

Using a DIY 16mm portable projector, the performance reimagines Tiger Balm, a traditional ointment from Singapore used to relieve pain and aches, in relation to one of its key ingredients camphor - historically used for celluloid production. Tiger balm ointment is used to create handmade chemigram sequences alongside inkjet-printed frames. Phantom spirits of tigers endlessly chase and are chased by the artists, veering between moments of both hope and futility of mass-manufactured relief to ever growing pains endured in our world.

title: Lomu
overview: A Tongan/Kiwi warrior who could run 100 metres in under 11 seconds. He was the youngest All Black to put on the jersey and still holds the record for the most tries scored in World Cup history.

title: Bucking Fastard
overview: Two sisters, Jean and Joan Holbrooke, are so close to each other that they speak in unison, love the same man, and have the same dreams. They even make the same slip of tongue in unison. We cannot see the world as they see it, but we do see how the world reacts to them – through the courts and the press, through those that want to help and those who want to use them, through the eyes of beasts both tame and wild, and even through their own echoes in the core of the earth.

title: Ketticè
overview: Palermo, 2012. Giulio, a listless and dissatisfied 16-year-old, drifts through his days with no enthusiasm for school and no prospects for the future. His encounter with Ketty, a more self-assured peer, offers him an escape from the monotony.

title: Ernie and Emma
overview: A pear salesman is left with some amusing duties and an urn of ashes after losing the love of his life.

title: Call Me by Your Name
overview: In the summer of 1983, a 17-year-old Elio spends his days in his family's villa in Italy. One day Oliver, a graduate student, arrives to assist Elio's father, a professor of Greco-Roman culture. Soon, Elio and Oliver discover a summer that will alter their lives forever.

title: The Gorals
overview: With 200 days left before college entrance exams, In-hye, who cares for the school's animal pen, spends her time lecturing a duck instead of studying. Seo-hee, punished for carrying a knife, joins her, and they discover an abandoned meadow where they lose the duck, Hee-seon. Meanwhile, teacher Kim Ah-tae forms a college interview prep group for four neglected students. On interview day, In-hye and Seo-hee ditch school to find Hee-seon, camping in the meadow and gradually learning to survive in the wild.

title: Body and Mind
overview: Unable to accept her lover's suicide, a woman refuses to believe he is gone. She dismembers his body and insists he was murdered. Yet the world remains haunted by his presence. As she forms a strange communion with his scattered body, fragments of their shared past resurface. Reality, memory, and dreams gradually dissolve into one another, blurring the boundaries between grief and truth.

title: Chronovisor
overview: A French academic is seduced into a world of untold histories in her scholarly quest to uncover the mystery of a history-capturing camera-like machine created by clandestine Benedictine monks. An academic-noir, armchair mystery in the lineage of Jorge Luis Borges and Umberto Eco.

title: The Atlas Field
overview: Afflicted by a terminal illness, Daniel convinces Henry to accompany him to the summit of a mountain they visited together during childhood. But their journey takes a dark turn as they enter the wilderness surrounding a mysterious project run by Sirevo, a secretive private corporation whose local operations have sparked intense scrutiny.  As unexplained phenomena multiply throughout the forest, the brothers are forced into a confrontation with an environment that defies explanation — a place where the rules of time bend, and the past may never have truly disappeared.

title: The Descent
overview: After a personal tragedy, Sarah joins her friends on a caving expedition in the Appalachian Mountains. But when a rockfall traps them deep underground, their adventure turns into a nightmare. As they search for a way out, the group discovers they are not alone—lurking in the darkness are savage, cave-dwelling creatures. With rising tension and dwindling trust, the women must fight to survive against both the predators and each other.

title: Mel
overview: A man recounts a dream to his doctor where he pursues a woman who feels hauntingly familiar.

title: How to Train Your Dragon
overview: As the son of a Viking leader on the cusp of manhood, shy Hiccup Horrendous Haddock III faces a rite of passage: he must kill a dragon to prove his warrior mettle. But after downing a feared dragon, he realizes that he no longer wants to destroy it, and instead befriends the beast – which he names Toothless – much to the chagrin of his warrior father.

title: Nothing Ever Leaves
overview: Nothing Ever Leaves tells the story of four friends who, after a tragic loss, try to cope with their grief together. As guilt, anger, and denial threaten to drive them further and further apart, they must confront the past in order to find a way forward.

title: Tethered
overview: Ayden, a man grappling with a fractured conscience, finds himself at the mercy of a methodical psychiatrist who pushes his unorthodox tactics to the extreme.

title: Air Jaws: Red, White and Breach
original_title: Air Jaws: Red, White and Breach
overview: Reports of great white sharks breaching off the California coast sparks an investigation to document the new phenomena.

title: Emily Catalano: The Introvert
overview: Comedian Emily Catalano explores her personality (or lack thereof) in her stand-up special The Introvert, filmed live at The Belly Up in San Diego.

title: Axanar: The Gathering Storm
overview: Set during the Four Years War between the Federation and the Klingon Empire, Axanar: The Gathering Storm continues the story begun in Prelude to Axanar. Captain Garth of Izar and his crew face the escalating conflict that will ultimately lead to the legendary Battle of Axanar.

title: K-Pop Shark Heroes
overview: Follows Ken Jeong and Rei Ami as they launch a public awareness campaign to reshape the perception of sharks across East Asia using K-Pop after shark encounters off the Korean Peninsula.

title: Instadocs: The Prediction Games
overview: Prediction markets let anyone bet on anything, from the World Cup to alien invasions. "Instadocs" investigates the explosive rise of global betting.

title: Corpus
overview: It’s the summer of 1998 in New York City; Sayo, a soulful nightlife photographer and small-time drug dealer, is invited to a party upstate by his longtime friend and unrequited love, a movie star on the rise: Vince Marlowe. Together with their rowdy friend Ross, they drive to a remote, bucolic manor in hopes of some summer debauchery. But when they arrive, they discover that the promise of a party is actually three mysterious women — Billie, Wren, and Cata — whose disturbing agenda draws the boys into a dark web of seduction and terror.

title: Congé
overview: On a rare day off, a mother and her son make the most of their time together, until an unexpected call turns everything upside down.

title: いってらっしゃいの花
original_title: いってらっしゃいの花

title: Rambo
overview: In Thailand, ex-Green Beret John James Rambo joins a group of mercenaries to venture into war-torn neighboring Myanmar to rescue a group of Christian aid workers who have been kidnapped by a ruthless local infantry unit.

title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity The Fool
original_title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity The Fool
overview: Before the gold chains, mohawk, and Hollywood fame of The A-Team and Rocky III, there was Laurence Tureaud. This is the extraordinary origin story behind one of the most unlikely and beloved icons in entertainment — Mr. T.

title: Booking
overview: Donna is a ride-hailing driver who sells her body to her passengers as extra service. But when she falls for her passenger Jane, will love stop Donna from doing the only way she knows how to pay her debts?

title: I'm Sick of Pizza
overview: A pizza delivery driver crosses paths with a bank robber.

title: Shrek the Third
overview: After the King of Far Far Away dies, Shrek and Fiona are to succede. However, Shrek wants to return to his cozy swamp and live in peace and quiet, so when he finds out there is another heir to the throne, he and Donkey set off to bring him back to rule the kingdom.

title: Euphoria: A Look Back
overview: The cast and crew of HBO's Euphoria take an exclusive look back at the critically acclaimed series' origins, evolution, and influences.

title: Sour Minnows
overview: Two friends stumble upon an unusual sight: six men sensually licking the pavement on an empty L.A. street. For Ricky, this moment ruptures something. As reality grows porous and memory begins to slip, a delirious new logic takes hold.

title: Swapnasundari
overview: A young man navigates the uncertainties of an arranged marriage. Torn between family expectations and his own ideals of love, he devises a unique way to find his perfect partner. But when reality blurs with his dreams, unexpected twists challenge his belief in love and destiny.

title: Chennai Love Story
overview: Two young people navigate their first experience of love, dealing with its powerful emotions and obstacles while discovering the delicate nature of newfound romance.

title: Drawn Together
overview: Marfil Cortés, a daughter of a wealthy Spanish businessman, is kidnapped and released, leading her father to hire Sebastian Moore as a bodyguard. Despite initial clashes, they form an irremediable attraction, navigating a world where no one is who they say they are.

title: A Woman's Life
overview: Gabrielle, a dedicated surgeon and head of a hospital department, is stretched thin by the weight of responsibility. There is little time left for her private life: a loving husband and a mother who depends on her care. Yet this is the life she wanted, the life she chose. When a novelist comes to observe her at work for a book, her balance begins to shift.

title: Demons at Dawn
overview: Orlando and Marco, two young men who live in Mexico City, meet by chance and fall in love. Every day they fight in order to achieve their dreams: Orlando wants to be a dancer and Marco wants to graduate from nursing school. As they go against a diverse, ever-changing, hostile world, they’ll learn that once the darkness of night is gone and through their intertwined bodies and their synchronized souls, they will have seen all those demons of dawn go by.

title: Comédie-Française
overview: At the Comédie-Française, there is one golden rule: the play is never canceled. Unfortunately for Nina, everything else is—just three hours before the premiere of her first staging. An actor is stuck on a train, tensions explode, equipment breaks down, egos clash, and panic sets in. With no way out and time slipping away, Nina must hold the show together at all costs. Will she make it until the curtain rises?

title: Jellyfish, The new Rulers of the Ocean
overview: Jellyfish blooms are making headlines around the world. This is due to the damage they cause to tourism, fishing and our health. How can these creatures, which are over 98% water and have no shell, skeleton or brain, expand so rapidly?  Although this is a normal stage in the life cycle of these gelatinous animals, we have to admit that blooms have become much more frequent and massive in recent decades. We're even witnessing jellyfish populations appearing in more and more regions where fish have been replaced by them, such as off the coast of Namibia, in the Black Sea, in the Sea of Japan and in certain areas of the Baltic Sea. What causes this? Why has the role of jellyfish in the ocean been underestimated, even though they outlived the dinosaurs? Are jellyfish on their way to dominating the oceans as they once did? What if they were to be the only ones left?

title: The Guy Next Door
overview: Three boys decide to finally explore and break in into there crazy neighbour on the street and look and explore his house and what happens next is crazy

title: Ratrace
overview: What would you do if you found a bag full of money?

title: Back To Buenos Aires
overview: It follows Mariano Guerra as he returns to Argentina to testify against soldiers who tortured him during the dictatorship, focusing not on revenge but on his inner struggle with guilt, trauma, and the lasting psychological impact of violence kept largely off-screen.

title: The Remotes
overview: A grieving detective finds himself increasingly ensnared while investigating a case involving a sinister navigation app causing physical and psychological debris.

title: Pension Patta
overview: A heartfelt story of identity, family, redemption, and the transformative power of humanity, where a simple pension document becomes the beginning of an extraordinary journey of self-discovery.

title: Haiwaan
overview: A retired judge faces difficulty keeping his daughter safe from a convict he imprisoned. Later, when he gets murdered, a man with visual impairment who was loyal to him tries to defend his daughter.

title: On Behalf of My Son
overview: Vicentina struggles to cope with the death of her son Wesley after a tragic bus accident, in which he was the driver. As the investigation unfolds, evidence suggests that Wesley’s actions may have been suicidal. Vicentina then embarks on a journey to seek out the victims’ families and apologize, while confronting her own grief and uncertainty.

title: Depths of Fear
overview: A team of divers enters one of the deepest holes in the ocean, but they discover more than they expected: something has made that deep hole its home and now they will have to fight for survival.

title: The Last DIY Show
overview: When a zombie apocalypse breaks out at a punk show, young show photographer Dahlia, her friends, and ex-boyfriend must band together to make it out alive.

title: The Thing
overview: A research team in Antarctica is hunted by a shape-shifting alien that assumes the appearance of its victims.

title: Under the Same Clouds
overview: On a quiet winter morning, Céline and Pierre, an elderly couple, go about their separate routines, never crossing paths. Their gestures speak of tenderness and a shared life. In the stillness of the snowy forest, they find each other once again.

title: Watcha Want
overview: A recent immigrant and trophy wife from Hong Kong rediscovers her love of dance after her wealthy husband's betrayal.

title: Fire Flies
overview: The filmmaker is led on a flashlight-illuminated stroll through the mountains—with the green, digital images of a night vision camera capturing flora, fauna, and distant stars.

title: The Toddling Youths
overview: Yaqin is a girl eager to see the world. WANG Jiong is a boy who stakes his career on a confession. These two newly graduated friends both want to escape their families and realise their self-worth. But when an imperfect society collides with an imperfect self, when cheerfulness becomes a mask, and when initial aspirations waver in reality, what kind of people will they turn out to be after this stumbling coming-of-age journey?

title: BLS - Body Life Support
overview: An awkward first aid instructor seeks intimacy with his student. Their questionable contact is fleeting, but for a silent witness from afar, it leaves a lifelong imprint.

title: Paradise Lost
overview: A psychological thriller that unfolds when Ryu Sun-woo, a son presumed dead in a school camping bus disappearance nine years ago, miraculously returns alive to his grieving mother, Ryu So-young.

title: Bad Lieutenant: Tokyo
overview: A corrupt gambler in the Metropolitan Police Force finds himself thrown into a tangled case after an enigmatic FBI agent arrives in Tokyo to investigate the disappearance of a politician’s daughter.

title: Nature of the Soul
overview: This is the tale of a girl whose soul was split between her body and a pendant she wore. When it slips off her neck one day, a fear awakens that a part of her could be lost…

title: Crowning at the Prom
overview: On the brink of prom queen glory and a coveted athletic scholarship, obsessive overachiever Kat Walker is determined to maintain the flawless image she's built for herself and for her devoted single mother, Abigail.

title: hey, pumpkin.
overview: After her recent marriage proposal, Dani’s night spirals into spilled coffee, unwanted advice, and relentless advertisements that seem to know her greatest fears. While picking up her sister from a party gone wrong, both women confront love, adulthood, and the possibility that none of this is as spontaneous as it feels.  This film is not sponsored, endorsed, or associated with the Starbucks Coffee Company.

title: CHERRY AND VIRGIN
overview: CHERRY AND VIRGIN—a 'nervous romance' about Ryou, a 32-year-old erotic manga artist who has no experience with women, and Ami, a 28-year-old fujoshi who has a bad impression of real men.

title: Brace Your Heart
overview: In a remote Sámi village high in the mountains, 20-year-old Ejva inherits her late father's reindeer herd. As she struggles to keep the herd thriving, local leader Heaika develops romantic feelings for her, and though hesitant, she feels compelled to accept. But everything changes when Nejla, Heaika's cousin, arrives, and Ejva discovers true love for the first time. Betrayed and jealous, Heaika reacts harshly, leaving Ejva with a condition that makes her hands shake uncontrollably, threatening her ability to care for the herd. Now, Ejva must find a way to reclaim control over her life and her future.

title: Sheldina
overview: Sheldina follows a group of 6 friends living in Emeryville, California in the 1960s and their job is to make movies, and they move up to Burbank so they can get better work.

title: Saturday Night's Main Event XLV
overview: Undisputed WWE Champion CM Punk joins forces with Cody Rhodes against Gunther and Sami Zayn, Danhausen competes in his first match at Madison Square Garden as he takes on JD McDonagh in a No Disqualification Match, and WWE Women's Tag Team Champions Paige and Brie Bella defend their title against Lainey Reid and Fallon Henley of Fatal Influence.

title: Capps Crossing: Wrong Side of Dead
original_title: Capps Crossing: Wrong Side of Dead
overview: When a behavioral science major investigates murders at Capps Crossing, she finds herself trapped in a twisted web of lies surrounding the local ranger and his son.

title: Drive
overview: Driver is a skilled Hollywood stuntman who moonlights as a getaway driver for criminals. Though he projects an icy exterior, lately he's been warming up to a pretty neighbor named Irene and her young son, Benicio. When Irene's husband gets out of jail, he enlists Driver's help in a million-dollar heist. The job goes horribly wrong, and Driver must risk his life to protect Irene and Benicio from the vengeful masterminds behind the robbery.

title: 300: Rise of an Empire
overview: Greek general Themistocles attempts to unite all of Greece by leading the charge that will change the course of the war. Themistocles faces the massive invading Persian forces led by mortal-turned-god, Xerxes and Artemesia, the vengeful commander of the Persian navy.

title: Kill Trip
overview: On the way to a Texas music festival, a group of friends catches a ride with a magnetic van driver. But when people start vanishing, the real headliner becomes survival.

title: Torsten Sträter: Mach mal das große Licht an
original_title: Torsten Sträter: Mach mal das große Licht an

overview: A story very loosely based the 480 B.C. Battle of Thermopylae, where the King of Sparta led his army against the advancing Persians.

title: The Chittering
overview: In an independent movie theater, a small documentary production investigates a conspiracy involving rodents. However, the crew becomes entangled in a web of mystery and darkness as they push the theater staff a little too far.

title: The Birthday Party
overview: Thomas, Nora and their teenage daughter Ida live on remote marshland. Social contact is limited, as they only have one neighbour, Cristina, an Italian painter. As the two households plan a surprise birthday party for Nora, strange disturbances begin to occur and unease rolls over the marsh.

title: Simulacra
overview: Nayan desperately attempts to help Nivi, who has been completely wiped blank, remember the profound past they once shared together.

title: Horsegirls
overview: As her mother battles an uncertain diagnosis, neurodivergent 22-year-old Margarita discovers a source of strength in an unexpected place: the sport of hobbyhorsing.

title: Lastri: Arwah Kembang Desa
overview: Atmi is terrorized by the spirit of Lastri, a woman who committed suicide 30 years ago due to slander and cruel treatment from her village. Now, Lastri has returned to seek revenge, especially on Atmi and those who destroyed her life.

title: Noche de Entierro
overview: Overwhelmed by her mother and tired of her grandmother's wake, Noelia escapes to a party with her best friend in search of a break. But leaving the wake proves much harder than she imagined.

title: Shark Frenzy
overview: A family vacation goes wrong when their daughter and her friends get lost at sea on a fishing boat. When that boat is destroyed, they survive in a row boat, then the open ocean. Her parents race to find her as sharks circle ever closer in a deadly fight for survival.

title: Joker
overview: During the 1980s, a failed stand-up comedian is driven insane and turns to a life of crime and chaos in Gotham City while becoming an infamous psychopathic crime figure.

title: Big Fish
overview: Throughout his life Edward Bloom has always been a man of big appetites, enormous passions and tall tales. In his later years, he remains a huge mystery to his son, William. Now, to get to know the real man, Will begins piecing together a true picture of his father from flashbacks of his amazing adventures.

title: Cek Khodam
overview: Nowadays, people are more afraid of empty wallets, late payments, and the end of the month than ghosts. Ghosts are even used as entertainment through the content Cek Khodam (Hodgkin's Check) created by three friends, Sakti, Wira, and Bima. Unbeknownst to them, their actions have drastically reduced the Human Fear Score (AKM). To restore the dignity of the supernatural world and raise the human fear score, the Commander of the Khodam is tasked with descending directly into the human world. However, the mission does not go according to plan. The harder the khodam try to scare humans, the more chaos they create.

title: Nonna
overview: Rosa, alone in her house in southern Italy which she built herself. Her children and grandchildren still live in Germany. This is not the way she thought it would be. Must she let go of her legacy?

title: No Name, No Address
overview: Sérgio is a charismatic radio host who presents the show "The Sound of Love", where he reads letters from people seeking help with their relationships and offers them advice. However, when a letter with no return address arrives at the show, Sérgio begins to spiral into a frenzy of guilt and sorrow.

title: 101 Dalmatians
overview: An evil, high-fashion designer plots to steal Dalmatian puppies in order to make an extravagant fur coat, but instead creates an extravagant mess.

title: Antarctic
overview: A brutal crime shocks an isolated Brazilian research station in Antarctica, transforming the enviroment filled with scientists and military personnel into a veritable pressure cooker. The men at the station become suspects, and a female deputy commander takes on the mission of investigating what happened and, with the support of the women at the base, faces silence and violence in her search for justice.

title: The Tale of Fairy Tales
overview: Modern-day Ivan dislikes fairy tales and doesn't believe in them. One day, he accidentally falls into a magic chest and finds himself in a world of fairy tales. To return home, Ivan must confront evil spirits, make friends, and accomplish a truly heroic feat.

title: Sarah
overview: After leaving the ultra-Orthodox world, 21-year-old Sarah sets out on a five-year journey, sparked by a raw, intimate expression of female vulnerability: an unplanned pregnancy. Without a permanent home, her changing body dictates the rhythm of her life as she moves between temporary apartments. Motherhood forces her to face herself, while the past she fled resurfaces. Caught between constant motion and inner withdrawal, Sarah struggles to form a new identity and find a place to call home.

title: Generations: The Evolution of Spider-Man
overview: Swing through twenty years of Spider-Man history—from Tobey Maguire and Andrew Garfield to Tom Holland. Explore the evolution of the iconic suits and stunts, follow Tom's journey into the mask, and get an exclusive look at Peter Parker's next chapter with Spider-Man: Brand New Day director Destin Daniel Cretton.

title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
original_title: Diary of a Mad Old Man
overview: A seventy year old widow recovers from a stroke in the care of his dysfunctional family. While his body is failing him, his libido still rages on – unwittingly sparked by the attentions of his daughter-in-law, a dancer with a shady past.

title: The Village of Eight Gravestones
overview: Based on the novel by Seishi Yokomizo, a detective is invited to a village that appears to have a mysterious curse put upon it

title: Beyond the Wetlands
overview: Two researchers from Karachi arrive at Hushe Valley near the K2 mountain for a research project on global warming. When one of the researcher vanishes into the cold and treacherous valley, a search and rescue mission is organized to find the missing person.

title: Men in Black II
overview: Kay and Jay reunite to provide our best, last and only line of defense against a sinister seductress who levels the toughest challenge yet to the MIB's untarnished mission statement – protecting Earth from the scum of the universe. It's been four years since the alien-seeking agents averted an intergalactic disaster of epic proportions. Now it's a race against the clock as Jay must convince Kay – who not only has absolutely no memory of his time spent with the MIB, but is also the only living person left with the expertise to save the galaxy – to reunite with the MIB before the earth submits to ultimate destruction.

title: The Social Network
overview: In 2003, Harvard undergrad and computer programmer Mark Zuckerberg begins work on a new concept that eventually turns into the global social network known as Facebook. Six years later, Mark is one of the youngest billionaires ever, but his unprecedented success leads to both personal and legal complications when he ends up on the receiving end of two lawsuits, one involving his former friend.

title: Repeat until she’s gone
overview: Haunted by her best friend’s recurring presence, Ivy begins to question whether the strange events around her are real or part of an endless cycle she cannot escape.

title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge on the Run
original_title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge on the Run
overview: When his best friend Gary is suddenly snatched away, SpongeBob takes Patrick on a madcap mission far beyond Bikini Bottom to save their pink-shelled pal.

title: The Croods
overview: The prehistoric Croods family live in a particularly dangerous moment in time. Patriarch Grug, his mate Ugga, teenage daughter Eep, son Thunk, and feisty Gran gather food by day and huddle together in a cave at night. When a more evolved caveman named Guy arrives on the scene, Grug is distrustful, but it soon becomes apparent that Guy is correct about the impending destruction of their world.

title: National Theatre Live: The Misanthrope
overview: Alice, a brilliant novelist, despises the hollow contemporary mantras of kindness and respect. But the bolder she becomes in speaking out, the more colleagues avoid her, and the more her personal relationships begin to fracture. As she challenges fashionable ideas and lends her voice to causes others are afraid to touch, she faces intense criticism and backlash. Alice will soon learn the price she must pay as an artist and as a woman for daring to speak her mind. Award-winner Sandra Oh is the Misanthrope in Martin Crimp's cutting new version of Molière's dark comedy, directed by National Theatre Director Indhu Rubasingham.

title: Good Morning Gaza
overview: Or Brandes, a reserve soldier serving in Gaza as a tank driver and a psychology student, broadcasts an improvised podcast to fellow soldiers over the military radio network. From candid conversations about fear and denial, to feelings of revenge, through jokes and absurd banter, the soldiers open up with striking honesty. Using excerpts from the radio communications alongside intimate footage from combat, the film offers a rare glimpse into the inner lives of soldiers in the aftermath of October 7th.

title: Still Water
overview: In 2008, as China basks in Olympic glory, Xi, a domestic worker, remains haunted by the loss of her sister in a devastating earthquake. When she learns of her sister’s reincarnation, she becomes drawn to her employer’s unborn child, convinced it is her sister.

title: Bedford Park
overview: Haunted by an abusive childhood, Audrey, a Korean American woman in her 30s, faces her emotional past. When her mother’s car accident brings her back to her parents’ home, she meets the man responsible for the accident. Their relationship builds, passions ignite, and they form a loving connection.

title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
overview: After surviving the Hunger Games, Katniss and Peeta struggle with the consequences of their victory as unrest spreads across Panem. Forced back into the spotlight, they become symbols of hope and resistance while the Capitol prepares a new and deadly challenge that will change the future of the nation forever.

title: Rocky
overview: Rocky Balboa is a Philadelphia club fighter who seems to be going nowhere. But when a stroke of fate puts him in the ring with a world heavyweight champion, Rocky knows that it's his one shot at the big time — a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to go the distance and come out a winner!
